note: Set A binds several values to identifiable details and components correctly (PL 4 1/2X4 1/2X1/2 in Floor Framing Detail C1, W10X15 in Duct Framing Detail 3, sheet title and revision rows), and its quotes are real page text. Set B repeats the same dimensions several times (6 7/8", 1'-4", 8", 1/4" TYP, scale), leaves most entities generic ("structural element", "dimension", "Duct Framing Detail"), and includes a fabricated value/quote "6'" for duct framing height that does not appear on the page. Both sets over-interpret unnamed dimensions (e.g. "offset to beam center", "side clearance to channel" in A; "overall height", "offset", "spacing" in B), but B does so more often and also misreads the detail scale as a bare "1 1/2"" value.
remarks: Both extractions attach engineering attributes (offset, clearance, internal dimension, spacing, height) to bare dimension strings whose actual witness lines cannot be verified from the text layer; at this image resolution the dimensioned feature is often ambiguous, so those claims are flagged as unsupported interpretations rather than definite misreads. Set B's "6' ft" claim with quote "6'" has no counterpart anywhere in the text layer (only 6", 6 7/8", and the 1 1/2' scale bar exist) and looks like an OCR/association error. Neither set captures the HSS 4 X 4 X 1/4 reference keynote or the C3X6 channel members, which are prominent on the sheet.
